title: Dynastic Turmoil Rises
next_chapter_hook: When Chen Ji followed the clues, he discovered that the person standing behind the Crown Prince was actually the mastermind who had insisted on breaking their engagement fifteen years ago. How should today's old scores be settled?

text.content:
In the Back Mountain of Tianqing Sect, within a concealed cave.

Chen Ji sat cross-legged, the Tianji Record Fragment hovering before him, emanating a faint golden glow. His brow was tightly knit, his fingers tapping lightly on his knees, the rhythm steady yet tinged with anxiety.

"The news of my faked death has spread." He murmured to himself, cold light flickering in his eyes. "It spread even faster than I anticipated."

He lifted his head, gazing at the sky beyond the cave. The shadow of the Heavenly Eye had not yet faded, yet the turbulence of the dynasty was already sweeping forth like monstrous waves. The hidden stakes he had laid over the years were being uprooted at a visible pace.

dialogue.content:
The barrier at the cave entrance rippled slightly as a figure slipped inside.

Su Qingyao wore a night-garb, her expression grave, clutching a Jade Slip in her hand. Upon seeing Chen Ji safe and sound, her tense shoulders relaxed slightly.

"You are quite leisurely." She冷哼一声, tossing the Jade Slip before Chen Ji. "News from the capital. Read it yourself."

Though her tone was cold, a trace of imperceptible worry lurked within her gaze.

text.content:
Chen Ji took the Jade Slip, his spiritual sense probing within.

A moment later, his lips curved slightly, forming a meaningful smile.

"His Highness the Crown Prince is certainly impatient." He chuckled softly, yet there was not a hint of amusement in his voice. "Within three days, he has eliminated seven of my hidden agents and confiscated three bases. This efficiency... even higher than I imagined."

His tone was calm, as if commenting on something utterly unrelated to himself. But Su Qingyao noticed the knuckles of his fingers gripping the Jade Slip had turned faintly white.

dialogue.content:
"Is that all your reaction?" Su Qingyao furrowed her brow. "Those hidden agents took you ten years to place, and now they've been completely uprooted—can you just watch?"

She stepped closer, lowering her voice: "Furthermore, the Princess has also made her move. She's sent people searching everywhere for your 'remains,' and in her words, she seems to know many things she shouldn't."

Her gaze fixed intently on Chen Ji: "How many things are you still hiding from me?"

text.content:
Chen Ji rose slowly, walking to the cave entrance, hands clasped behind his back.

Moonlight fell upon his face, carving a cold and sharp contour. He did not immediately answer Su Qingyao's question, but instead gazed at the distant night sky, his eyes deep as an abyss.

"A ten-year layout, cleared in three days." He said softly. "On the surface, it seems I've lost."

He turned to face Su Qingyao, a faint smile curling his lips: "But Qingyao, do you know? A true chess master never concerns himself with the loss of a single piece or piece of territory."

choice.prompt: Facing Su Qingyao's questioning and Chen Ji's seemingly detached attitude, as a reader, you would choose:

choices.description: Deliberately show weakness, making the Crown Prince and Princess believe Chen Ji has completely failed, while secretly observing their hidden cards.
choices.visible_reward: See the enemy's true cards clearly, avoid打草惊蛇
choices.risk_hint: If the enemy is stronger than imagined, may miss the opportunity for counterattack

text.content: "Since they want my 'remains,' then give them some." Chen Ji drew several pre-prepared Jade Slips from his sleeve, a calculating gleam flickering in his eyes. "These things will tell them what I want them to know."

dialogue.content:
Su Qingyao took the Jade Slips, her spiritual sense scanning them, her expression shifting slightly: "These are... false intelligence?"

"No, real intelligence." Chen Ji shook his head. "But it's half-truth and half-false. Enough to make them believe, yet enough to make them err."

choices.description: Activate the Tianji Record to foresee the next three hours, observe the Crown Prince and Princess's specific movements, and find the true mastermind behind the scenes.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain critical intelligence, lock onto the mastermind's identity
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate is extremely precious, abuse will bring divine backlash

text.content:
Chen Ji closed his eyes, his fingers gently pressing against the Tianji Record mark between his brows. In an instant, golden light flared again, an enigmatic power enveloping him.

Three breaths later, he abruptly opened his eyes, his pupils reflecting a blurry image.

dialogue.content:
"What did you see?" Su Qingyao asked nervously.

Chen Ji's face was somewhat pale, clearly having consumed much. But the brilliance in his eyes burned even brighter: "The person standing behind the Crown Prince—I saw a silhouette. The events of fifteen years ago... may not be as simple as they seem."

choices.description: Temporarily remain still, let the enemy continue their purge, wait for them to expose greater flaws before striking lethally.
choices.visible_reward: When the enemy relaxes their guard, they expose more flaws, gaining an excellent opportunity for counterattack
choices.risk_hint: If the enemy finds key evidence first, may lose everything

text.content:
"Let them purge." Chen Ji sat back down, his voice terrifyingly calm. "I want to see exactly how big the Crown Prince's appetite truly is."

His fingers tapped his knees again, but the rhythm had become even slower, each tap like a countdown.

dialogue.content:
"Are you really that confident?" Su Qingyao watched him, a vague unease stirring in her heart.

Chen Ji smiled faintly: "Not confident—I've already lost everything. Since there's nothing left to lose, every step forward from here is pure profit."

text.content:
Meanwhile, in the Eastern Palace of the capital.

The Crown Prince sat in the main seat, a row of black-clad secret guards kneeling before him. A smug smile played on his face as he toyed with a Jade Pendant—the very one Chen Ji had carried.

"A废物 is still a废物." He sneered contemptuously. "Even if he plays some petty tricks, he's merely a clown jumping on stage."

He tossed the Jade Pendant to the strategist beside him: "Issue the order, continue the search. This prince wants to know exactly how much more this废物 has hidden."

And in another corner of the capital, within the Princess's residence.

A maid hurried into the secret chamber, cradling a rosewood box in her hands. The Princess took the box and opened it—inside lay a fragmentary Jade Slip, inscribed with patterns resembling the Tianji Record.

"Found it." A meaningful smile curled the Princess's lips. "Chen Ji, Chen Ji, did you really think faking your death could deceive this princess? The deeper you hide, the more this princess wishes to know what you are scheming."

She tucked the Jade Slip into her sleeve, a complex gleam flickering in her eyes.

dialogue.content:
Back in the cave, Su Qingyao reported the intelligence she had gathered one by one.

"The Crown Prince's purge is escalating. It's not just your hidden agents—even innocent officials are being implicated." She furrowed her brow. "He's gone mad."

After listening, Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, then spoke slowly: "Madness is good. A mad enemy makes more mistakes."

choice.prompt: Facing the Crown Prince's increasingly frantic actions, Chen Ji must decide his next move:

choices.description: Activate the final hidden piece embedded near the Crown Prince, letting him taste the bitterness of defeat at his moment of greatest triumph.
choices.visible_reward: The Crown Prince loses face in court, his prestige plummets
choices.risk_hint: If the hidden piece is discovered, will lose all cards for a comeback

text.content:
Chen Ji drew a special transmission Talisman Paper from his chest, his fingers gently pinching it. The Talisman Paper dissolved into a stream of light vanishing into the night.

"Go, and let His Highness the Crown Prince understand what it means to have joy turn to sorrow." His voice was tranquil as water.

dialogue.content:
Su Qingyao watched that stream of light, her expression complex: "This Talisman Paper... is it your final hidden piece?"

"Yes and no." Chen Ji smiled faintly. "The hidden piece has been activated, but this is merely the beginning. If His Highness wishes to play, this Marquis shall accompany him properly."

choices.description: Proactively reach out to the Princess's faction, leveraging her interest in the 'remains' to establish a delicate cooperative relationship.
choices.visible_reward: Find new pieces within the enemy's ranks, gain a crucial intelligence channel
choices.risk_hint: The Princess's stance is unclear, may be letting a wolf into the house

text.content:
Chen Ji drew a special token from his sleeve, inscribed with a subtle symbol.

"This is the token I kept from my previous dealings with the Princess." He handed the token to Su Qingyao. "Trouble you to make a trip. Tell her that Chen Ji still has an 'item' he wishes to trade with her."

dialogue.content:
Su Qingyao took the token but did not leave immediately. She stared at Chen Ji, a trace of vigilance flickering in her eyes: "What exactly are you planning? Cooperating with the Princess is no different from making a pact with a tiger."

"Qingyao, sometimes the greatest enemy can also become the best tool." A sharp gleam flashed in Chen Ji's eyes. "Moreover, what the Princess knows may be far more than we imagined."

choices.description: Continue to remain idle, let the Crown Prince's frantic purge provoke greater backlash, and reap the fisherman's profit.
choices.visible_cost: Unable to cut losses in time
choices.visible_reward: The Crown Prince arouses public anger, naturally someone will act on Chen Ji's behalf
choices.risk_hint: If the Crown Prince stops in time, will miss the opportunity

text.content:
Chen Ji closed his eyes again, hands forming seals, appearing to enter a meditative state.

"No rush." He murmured. "Let the bullet fly a while longer."

dialogue.content:
Su Qingyao watched his state, helplessly sighing. She knew once this man made a decision, it was difficult to change.

"Fine, do as you please." She turned toward the cave entrance. "I'll monitor the outside. If anything happens, I'll come find you."

text.content:
The night deepened, the capital's clamor gradually calming.

Yet in corners unknown to all, a greater storm was brewing. The Crown Prince's Great Purge had ignited panic among court officials, many beginning to collude in secret. The Princess, after obtaining that Jade Slip, began studying its secrets through the night. And Chen Ji, though in the shadows at Tianqing Sect, seemed to have an invisible hand weaving an enormous net.

This night was destined to be sleepless.

dialogue.content:
Just as Su Qingyao was about to step out of the cave, Chen Ji suddenly spoke: "Qingyao."

She stopped in her tracks, turning to look at him.

Chen Ji did not turn around, only saying calmly: "It may get very dangerous from here. If you wish to leave, there's still time."

Su Qingyao was silent for a moment, then冷哼一声: "You think I would abandon a废物 like you and run?"

She walked into the night without looking back, her voice drifting back clearly: "Don't die too soon. You still owe me an explanation."

text.content:
Chen Ji gazed at her departing figure, a faint smile appearing on his lips.

"Holds grudges but not reckless... rather similar to me." He murmured to himself, then收敛了笑容, his expression growing deep and profound once more.

He drew the Tianji Record Fragment from his chest, golden light glinting in the darkness. He stared at the patterns on the Fragment, his mind recalling the moment his sister Chen Nian opened her eyes, and that terrifying voice—

"Heavenly Fate is not dead, the Heavenly Eye has never departed."

choice.prompt: Beyond all schemes and plots, Chen Ji must also decide how to face the threat of the Heavenly Eye:

choices.description: Attempt to contact Mo Xiansheng, the residual soul guardian within the Tianji Record, seeking intelligence about the Heavenly Eye.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain crucial intelligence about the Heavenly Eye, unravel some of the mystery
choices.risk_hint: Mo Xiansheng's help often comes with an even greater price

text.content:
Chen Ji sank his spiritual sense into the Tianji Record Fragment, gently rapping on the first page. A moment later, a illusory figure slowly emerged from the Fragment—it was Mo Xiansheng.

"Young one, you seek me again." Mo Xiansheng's voice was aged and ethereal. "Speak then, what do you wish to know this time?"

dialogue.content:
"The Heavenly Eye." Chen Ji asked directly. "What exactly is it? Why did it choose me?"

Mo Xiansheng was silent for a long time, only speaking after a long pause: "This question, old me cannot fully answer for you yet. But I can tell you one thing—the Heavenly Eye is not gazing upon you for the first time."

His eyes flickered with a complex light: "The broken engagement fifteen years ago... may be related to it."

choices.description: Without external assistance, use one's own wisdom and the power of the Tianji Record to deduce the true purpose of the Heavenly Eye.
choices.visible_cost: Consumes massive energy, may go into走火入魔
choices.visible_reward: Independently discover key clues, impressions are deeper
choices.risk_hint: The deduction results may be inaccurate, and will expose one's location

text.content:
Chen Ji closed his eyes, pouring all his focus into the Tianji Record. Golden light swirled around him as countless enigmatic runes materialized in the air.

He began deducing, starting from the broken engagement fifteen years ago, tracing the threads of destiny piece by piece.

dialogue.content:
Who knows how long passed before he abruptly opened his eyes, his pupils reflecting a blurry image—a figure standing behind the Crown Prince, that figure's silhouette...

"It's him!" Shock flashed in Chen Ji's eyes. "The person who forced me to break my engagement fifteen years ago is actually connected to the Crown Prince!"

His fists clenched tightly, knuckles white: "So that's how it is... from the very beginning, I've been part of someone's scheme."

choices.description: Temporarily shelve the Heavenly Eye threat, focus on the power struggle in the dynasty, reconsider once the situation stabilizes.
choices.visible_cost: May miss the best opportunity to reveal the truth
choices.visible_reward: Stabilize the current situation, accumulate more筹码 for subsequent actions
choices.risk_hint: The enemy may take the opportunity to complete their own layout

text.content:
Chen Ji withdrew the Tianji Record Fragment into his body, taking a deep breath.

"Forget it, the matter of the Heavenly Eye can wait." He stood up, cold light flickering in his eyes. "The greatest enemy before me is the Crown Prince and his hidden mastermind."

dialogue.content:
He walked to the cave entrance, gazing toward the capital, his voice low and icy: "Your Highness the Crown Prince, since you so wish to play, this Marquis shall accompany you for a proper game."

"The account from fifteen years ago—today, I begin to settle it!"

text.content:
Meanwhile, in a secluded mansion somewhere in the capital.

A figure in a black robe sat in the main seat, his features hidden within the shadows, only a pair of deep and icy eyes visible.

"Chen Ji is dead?" His voice was hoarse and deep. "No, he is not. This little废物 is more troublesome than I imagined."

He stood and walked to the window, gazing at the capital's night: "Since you fake death, then this one shall help you continue this play."

The black-robed figure turned, speaking to the shadows behind him: "Issue the order, have the Crown Prince accelerate the purge. This one wishes to see just how long this废物 can remain composed."

A cold, sinister smile curled his lips: "Fifteen years, little whelp of the Chen family, did you think you could escape this one's grasp?"

"The Tianji Record... shall ultimately belong to this one."

In the Back Mountain of Tianqing Sect, Chen Ji seemed to sense something, his brow center twitching.

He opened his eyes, gazing toward the capital, a fierce killing intent flickering within.

"Found you." He murmured, his voice carrying suppressed rage. "Behind the Crown Prince, there is indeed a person."

He stood, blazing fighting intent burning in his eyes: "Since you wish to play, this Marquis shall accompany you properly. The account from fifteen years ago—"

"I will make you repay it, item by item!"

Night wind howled, stirring Chen Ji's robes.

His silhouette stretched long beneath the moonlight, like a dormant beast finally baring its fangs.

The winds of the dynasty have already churned, and an even greater storm approaches. And this time, Chen Ji no longer chooses to endure—he will take the initiative, sweeping all enemies lurking in the shadows into one net.

The truth of fifteen years ago approaches daylight. And the hidden hand behind the Crown Prince shall soon emerge.

Yet what he does not know is this—a pair of invisible eyes watches all his movements from the darkness...

When Chen Ji followed the clues, he discovered that the person standing behind the Crown Prince was actually the mastermind who had insisted on breaking their engagement fifteen years ago. How should today's old scores be settled?
